title: Art sales
summary: Acquire works by the artists we represent, or sell through the gallery.
body: Tell us what you are looking for and we will put together options from the artists we represent, with prices and provenance. Collectors who wish to sell a work can also approach the gallery for an appraisal and placement.

title: Gallery on rent
summary: Hire the Chennai or Bengaluru gallery for exhibitions and events.
body: Both spaces can be hired for exhibitions, launches, talks and private events, with the gallery team on hand for hanging and lighting. Share your dates and the kind of event to receive availability and terms.

title: Art for rent
summary: Rent artworks for offices, hospitality spaces and productions.
body: Original works can be rented for a fixed term for offices, hotels, restaurants, film and photo shoots, with delivery, installation and insurance arranged by the gallery. Rentals can be renewed or converted into a purchase.

title: Corporate painting execution
summary: Commissioned paintings and murals for corporate spaces, executed end to end.
body: We brief artists, manage production and oversee installation of commissioned paintings and murals for lobbies, boardrooms and campuses. Send the site details and the scale you have in mind to start a conversation.

title: Turn-key art projects
summary: Art programmes for new buildings and interiors, from concept to installation.
body: For new buildings and interiors we plan the collection, commission or source the works, and handle framing, transport and installation as one project. Architects, developers and interior designers can involve us at any stage.
